operations.name: Julián Montalan

expected.sentence: Captured during the suppression of the Sakay movement and reportedly given a life sentence; exact arrest and release dates are less complete than for Sakay and Carreón, so release date is omitted.

updates.sentence:
Captured during the suppression of the Sakay movement and reportedly given a life sentence; exact arrest and release dates are less complete than for Sakay and Carreón, so release date is omitted.

The Philippine Bureau of Prisons catalogue, revised June 1927, confirms that Montalan was serving a life term at Iwahig in 1914. It reports that he subsequently received executive clemency, conditional on not returning to the provinces associated with his case. The report does not give the date of clemency or physical release.

operations.research_note: Philippine Bureau of Prisons catalogue, revised June 1927, printed page 9. Original visually inspected. Confirms life sentence at Iwahig in 1914 and later conditional executive clemency, without supplying release date. No date inferred from the uprising.
